_comment: Pass A — whole-string rules. These paired fill+text strings are the status-badge vocabulary, copy-pasted into ~16 inlined maps across the admin pages. Resolving them as WHOLE strings is what keeps `bg-blue-100` (a brand avatar tile) distinct from `bg-blue-100 text-blue-800` (an 'accepted' status badge). Order matters: this pass runs before any single-class map.
